secrets.name: META_APP_ID
secrets.description: Meta app ID (developers.facebook.com > App settings > Basic). Optional: enables Meta OAuth.

secrets.name: META_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Meta app secret (same page). Optional: enables Meta OAuth.

secrets.name: META_REDIRECT_URI
secrets.description: OAuth callback: https://3000-<preview host>/auth/meta/callback; must also be registered in the Meta app's Valid OAuth Redirect URIs.

secrets.name: META_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Random string, at least 32 characters, used to encrypt the session cookie.
